implementation.discovery: Inspect the current host tool catalog and schemas; verify reference input and result delivery before invoking.
implementation.invocation: Use the current host image-viewing tool to inspect actual local source, reference and output pixels; require a vision-capable model.
implementation.configuration: Host-managed account and provider authorization; no credentials bundled.

implementation.discovery: Run scripts/check-media.mjs; use its verified invocation and load the current toapiscli SKILL.md. Default is the sibling Skill in this host; explicit CLOUD_HUG_TOAPIS_SKILL_ROOT selects a nonstandard directory.
implementation.invocation: Follow references/media-execution.md. Inspect model docs, submit ordered local references with image generate, then recover via task get/wait --directory using the original output directory. Inspect actual downloaded pixels.
implementation.configuration: Required @petercjl/toapiscli >=0.1.1 in its own managed .runtime; existing protected credentials, network and balance remain external.
implementation.failure: Missing/incompatible runtime pauses generation. Preserve the request directory on failure/uncertainty; do not silently switch provider or resubmit.

evidence: toapiscli 0.1.1 command contracts inspected; CLI testing and native host discovery are separate evidence.

notes: Generation uses the current-host toapiscli managed runtime. Deliver images and manifest only. Host-native viewing and discovery require separate verification.
local_execution: Use this installed Skill’s scripts/run.mjs for owning-package commands; resolve external media through its independently managed canonical contract.
